nodes.text: What is the largest $k$ such that in any permutation of $\mathbb{Z}$ there must exist a monotone $k$-term arithmetic progression $x_1<\cdots<x_k$?

#195 : [ErGr79] [ErGr80] arithmetic progressions Geneson [Ge19] proved that $k\leq 5$. Adenwalla [Ad22] proved that $k\leq 4$. See also [194] and [196] .
